_note: Copy this file to config/color-contract.json and fill every value from your own design token and measurement. config/color-contract.json is the single source of truth for conversion, audit, finalize and gate stages. Do not copy these values into scripts.
_setup: brandColor must name an entry under colors. It is the canonical brand colour.
Each colour needs figma.rgbHex, cmyk.percent (four values), cmyk.bytes8 (four values) and cmyk.tacPercent.
regions map a Figma node to the paint node that covers it. A job with no matching region fails pdf.brandgreen instead of passing silently.
profiles.*.path points at a local ICC file. shasum -a 256 it and paste the hash. The source profile is the one the RGB source PDF must embed.
Every CMYK value here is a stored operator value for the target profile, not a physical measurement.

BRAND_GREEN.description: Canonical brand surface colour for this job.

regions.label: replace-with-region-label
regions.note: Replace with the real Figma node id, bbox and a sample rectangle that contains only this colour.

SECONDARY_GREEN.description: Separate semantic colour. Never merge it into BRAND_GREEN.

source.description: sRGB2014 or your source RGB profile
source.policy: The source PDF must embed exactly this profile. Untagged RGB or any other RGB profile is refused.

target.outputCondition: ISO Coated v2 300% (ECI), FOGRA39L, ISO 12647-2:2004/Amd 1, TAC 300%
target.policy: The conversion target and the single PDF/X-4 OutputIntent profile. DeviceCMYK artwork is interpreted through this OutputIntent; no ICCBased CMYK re-declaration of the same profile is allowed.

renderRGB.description: sRGB2014 or your proof RGB profile
renderRGB.policy: Explicit destination for every ICC-managed RGB render used by proof and Gate 3.

conversion.note: One controlled RGB to CMYK conversion. Intent and BPC are recorded and verified on control patches; they are not inferred from the renderer.

pdf.defaultCMYKPolicy: No /DefaultCMYK in printable content. DeviceCMYK under one matching CMYK OutputIntent is the supported model. An ICCBased CMYK default space identical to the OutputIntent is a reader-dependent re-mapping hazard and is excluded by this workflow.

acceptance.quantization: 8-bit byte equality, plus a raw percent deviation of at most 0.05 percentage points from the approved tuple
acceptance.managedRenderControl: A deliberately different CMYK output profile must change the plate reading. If it does not, the renderer is not colour-managed and the gate must fail.
acceptance.note: All values are stored operator values and ICC predictions, not physical measurements. Printer RIP output space, contract proof and press measurement remain external.
